category_title: Students using informal visuospatial representations for arithmetical reasoning
minimal_context: The student is working alongside a peer to determine how many 25-seater buses are needed for 100 people.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Here is the next problem for you both. There are 100 people waiting, and they need to fit into 25-seater buses. How many buses will they need?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Draws a large box on the paper) I'm going to draw the buses and put one mark for each person. Counting them out is the most efficient way for me to do this.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Carefully drawing individual tally marks inside the first container) ...twenty-three, twenty-four, twenty-five. That's one bus. Now I'll draw another bus and add more marks.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Your partner just mentioned that they have finished the task. Just keep going with yours.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Looks over at the partner's paper and stops drawing) They finished already? I need to go faster. I can't draw all these marks now, it takes too long. I'm stuck.
